systemSummary.name: Netflix Conductor Workflow Orchestration Engine
systemSummary.description: Microservices and workflow orchestration engine executing JSON-defined DAG workflows with queue-based worker task dispatch, pluggable persistence, and delayed sweeper reconciliation.

coreEngine.description: Central orchestration engine hosting WorkflowExecutor, DeciderService, TaskMappers, and EventProcessors.

reconciliationSubsystem.description: Background sweeping and repair daemons ensuring workflow progress across host crashes and dropped messages.

queueLayer.description: Pluggable distributed task queuing abstractions supporting Redis, DynoQueue, SQS, AMQP, and relational DBs.

persistenceLayer.description: Data access objects for metadata, execution state, and indexing (Cassandra, Redis, MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch).

lockingSubsystem.description: Distributed locking mechanisms serializing concurrent workflow evaluations across cluster nodes.

durableExecutionModel.dagEvaluation: Workflows are defined as explicit JSON DAGs (WorkflowDef) containing task nodes (SIMPLE, FORK_JOIN, DECISION, DO_WHILE, SUB_WORKFLOW, DYNAMIC). DeciderService evaluates current task outcomes and schedules downstream tasks without code replay.
durableExecutionModel.queueBasedDispatch: Tasks are scheduled by pushing message IDs to queues. External workers poll queues, receive tasks with visibility timeout leases, execute application logic, and call updateTask to record output.
durableExecutionModel.reconciliationSweeper: Active workflows are enqueued in delayed sweep queues. WorkflowSweeper periodically inspects running executions to enforce task timeouts, retry expired unacknowledged tasks, and trigger evaluation.
durableExecutionModel.distributedLocking: Workflow executions are protected by distributed locks (RedisLock, ZookeeperLock, LocalOnlyLock) acquired during decide() to prevent concurrent state mutations.
durableExecutionModel.statePersistence: Concrete workflow and task execution models are persisted directly to storage DAOs. Audit and visibility search indexes are decoupled via ExecutionDAOFacade.
